title: Marketplace
notConnectedYet: Marketplace will be built in P12.

browser.title: Partners directory
browser.subtitle: Verified partners and offers. The crown comes only from a live verification record, never from a user-written field.
browser.crownNote: The Verified badge appears only with a live verification record. Demo values are labeled and are not real prices.
browser.searchPlaceholder: Search by partner name or description
browser.emptyDescription: Widen or clear the filters. You can populate demo data from developer settings.
browser.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching partners. Please retry.
browser.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

profile.title: Partner profile
profile.notFoundDescription: We could not find this partner. It may have been removed or the link is invalid.
profile.notVerifiedNote: This partner is not verified right now. No verification badge is shown; confirm details before dealing.

offers.title: Partner offers
offers.subtitle: Published offers only. Drafts and in-review offers never appear here.
offers.emptyDescription: Offers appear after review and publication. No demo offer is presented as real.

detail.title: Offer details
detail.howNote: Contact the partner directly and mention you are from AZIB. No in-app payment and no commission; eligibility is checked at the partner without revealing your identity to anyone else.
detail.audienceNote: The beneficiary category is a provisional policy: approved beneficiaries only for now.
detail.viewsSuppressed: View count is withheld to protect privacy at small numbers.
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this offer. It may have been cancelled or the link is invalid.

audience.pendingPolicy: This option awaits approval of the beneficiary-category policy.

external.whatsappDescription: WhatsApp will open with the partner's number. No data from your account is sent, and you will leave the app.
external.mapsDescription: Your maps app will open at the partner's location. You will leave the app.
external.failed: Could not open the external app. Please try again.

report.title: Report an offer
report.received: Your report was received and will be reviewed by the responsible team. Thank you for keeping the directory accurate.

saved.title: Saved offers
saved.subtitle: Your private list. Nobody else can see it.
saved.emptyDescription: Save any offer from its details screen to see it here.
saved.privateNote: Saving is local to your account and is not shared with the partner or any other user.

demo.notice: Every partner and offer here is demo data and does not represent real businesses or prices.

validation.title: Enter an offer title (at least 3 characters).
validation.discountValue: Enter a valid value greater than zero.
validation.percentRange: The discount rate must not exceed 100.
validation.validityWindow: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.reportDetail: Describe the report in at least 10 characters.

errors.noSession: Sign-in is required for this action.
